name: tcs_financial_research
description: Produce a comprehensive financial research report and compliance review for Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS).

tasks.subject: Gather Financial Data for TCS.NS
tasks.description: Gather comprehensive price snapshots, valuation multiples, fundamentals, quarterly financials, and peer benchmarks for TCS.NS.
tasks.objective: Collect complete financial and market data for TCS.NS.
acceptance: All financial metrics, valuation multiples, quarterly financials, and peer comparisons for TCS.NS are successfully gathered.

tasks.subject: Execute AML & Compliance Screening for TCS
tasks.description: Run structured AML sweep and adverse media search for Tata Consultancy Services.
acceptance: AML sweep across 8 structured databases and adverse media search for TCS are fully executed and recorded.

tasks.subject: Validate Data and Render PDF Report
tasks.description: Validate gathered data sufficiency, plan report sections, audit draft claims, and render the final PDF report.
tasks.objective: Validate data and render the final credit & research report PDF.
acceptance: Data sufficiency is validated, report format is planned, and final report PDF is successfully rendered.
